description:
RE-SCOPED (owner decision, 2026-07-02): bring RuntimeDemand inline with the northstar — not another compensator.

THE NORTHSTAR LAW (northstar.html): "The loop reaches a fixpoint because job keys coalesce, fact slots JOIN contributions, and changed revisions wake exactly the jobs that read or waited on those slots" and "There is no second type-fixpoint loop hiding behind this. The joined activation fact IS the loop." Slots are join-semilattices; contributions only ascend; quiescence IS the fixpoint. The codebase already implements this correctly for a cyclic product: ExecutableEffects (jobs/artifact.rs collect_effect_cone -> effect_scc_containing -> settle_effect_scc) — SCC discovered by product recursion, monotone Kleene ascent from bottom ENTIRELY INSIDE the producer, only the SETTLED value ever published (audited in fz-go4.18.3).

THE FOUNDING DEFECT (earliest sour point): return-demand was NOT modeled as a joined fact slot — it is a replaceable PullSession map (recompute_return_demand = fold-and-REPLACE) whose values are READABLE BY OTHER PRODUCTS BEFORE THE CYCLE THEY PARTICIPATE IN HAS SETTLED. Every downstream mechanism is a compensator for premature reads, each begetting the next: (1) whole-by-need seed (runtime_demand.rs:182-185, fabricate Whole for a no-contribution read); (2) retractable contributions (.18.3.2.4, un-fabricate #1 for discarded callees); (3) consumed-return floor (runtime_demand.rs:544-558, "correct" a mid-ascent Ignore from the static body); (4) active-SCC seed (runtime_demand.rs:195-196/:471, fabricate for SCC re-entry); (5) unconditional cone wipes (the damper). The proven period-2 orbit (this ticket's diagnosis) is #3 consuming #4's fabrication, withdrawn by #2, re-triggered by #5. The same defect explains ALL FIVE .18.12 findings: .18.18's discarded placeholder = artifact reading demand pre-settlement; .18.17's identical re-productions = wipes re-deriving mid-ascent states; .18.21's schedule-dependent arrows = keys minted from mid-ascent values.

THE FIX (correct-by-construction, the effects pattern):
1. RuntimeDemand(E) settles its demand SCC INSIDE the producer: discover the SCC (callers<->callees; cone recursion exists), run a monotone ascent from TRUE bottom (Ignore = no evidence yet, honestly) over the whole SCC — input demands down edges, return demands up, ShapeDemand::join per iteration (already a correct semilattice) — publish ONLY the settled fixpoint for every member. Unique least fixpoint => deterministic, schedule-independent by construction.
2. No unsettled reads: outside the ascent, RuntimeDemand(E) exists settled or you WAIT (ordinary product contract). No third state to fabricate for.
3. DELETE the compensators: whole-by-need seed (bottom-start is safe once mid-ascent values cannot leak — the 10-test regression that forced Whole was a premature-read casualty); active-SCC seed (SCC solved together, never re-entered); consumed-return floor (at the fixpoint the callee's real input demand is present, so the demand is DERIVED — retain the static body fact only as a debug assertion: a settled consumed return must be non-Ignore).
4. Retraction shrinks to its honest scope: epoch events only (re-materialization changes the call graph -> re-key + re-settle the SCC); within a settlement contributions only ascend. Mirrors the facts-layer law: only rebase retracts.
5. The cone wipes become real invalidation; the .18.17 stop-at-unchanged gate becomes trivially sound (its livelock was OF THE ORBIT, not of the gate) and mostly unnecessary.

WHAT MELTS AWAY: the floor, both seeds, in-flight retraction, the wipe-damper's reason to exist, .18.18's placeholder production, most of .18.20's churn, .18.21's non-determinism, and (per the census: 100% of cycling keys are RuntimeDemand) the bulk of the fz-go4.22 matrix redness.

DESIGN RISK -> feasibility probe first (fz-go4.18.22.1): demand SCCs may be large (whole recursion webs) and the demand lattice is richer than the effects bitset; the ascent must be bounded (finite lattice height is the argument — MEASURE it, esp. on 00420 enum_take_drop_split). Probe before committing to the implementation.

ACCEPTANCE: orbit fixture (fz_f98_range_map_converges) converges monotonically with NO seed/floor/in-flight retraction; the preserved .18.17 wavefront gate applied on top does NOT livelock (definitive probe); cycling census (per-key value-history detector) -> 0 matrix-wide; 3-run product fingerprints identical on the formerly-cycling fixtures; suite green 3x; compensator code deleted (rg-proof); docs (northstar/semantic-fixpoint/fact-engine) updated to state demand settles SCC-locally like effects.
REJECTED ALTERNATIVES (recorded): provisional-when-seeded flag (compensator #6); widen-at-conflict (bakes the seed fiction, loses destination-passing precision in reduce loops); pure wavefront gating (livelocks); SCC damping (mixed-state miscompile). The prior orbit diagnosis + census are in this ticket's comments; the .18.17 WIP gate patch is preserved in the session scratchpad.
title: Model RuntimeDemand as an SCC-settled monotone fixpoint (the ExecutableEffects pattern); delete the seed/floor/in-flight-retraction compensators
